notes.title: An interview with Mandy!
notes.content:
Hello there to all of you amazing "Mandy's Room" fans. We've been hard at work on our next amazing game, which will be announced very soon, and we hope will blow you all away. And we are also working on the free DLC for Mandy's Room 2.

In the meantime, we've decided to post a little "interview" we did with Mia Sloane, the amazing voice actress for Mandy. We all know that her voice is Sexy AF, so we thought you all might enjoy getting to know her a little better. Here is what she had to say:

[i]When I “met” Mandy and Mr. J, I’d never done erotica before. I auditioned on a whim, and I couldn’t have been more surprised when I got cast. Apparently, I had a secret talent for erotica! I went into my vocal booth an erotica virgin and came out addicted. I found that the more I acted aroused and excited, the more aroused and excited I got! Just like Mandy, I knew I wanted to do more. 

I was really surprised at how natural this part felt. The team at HFTGames was incredibly professional and respectful, but they encouraged me to improv where I wanted to. So, I let my inner freak off her leash and said a few things off-script, and the team loved it. The game got naughtier, and we knew we had the start of a great collaboration. 

As I started exploring more erotic work outside of Mandy’s Room, I had to figure out what my boundaries were. After testing the waters, I made a hard and fast (pun intended) rule: if it doesn’t turn ME on, I’m not going to do it. The opposite is also true: if I think it’s sexy, I want to voice it! So in case you’re out there wondering if I’m just acting— it’s just as hot for me imagining YOU out there, listening to me and getting off, as I hope it is for you. It's a really safe way to be an exhibitionist, honestly. 

That's why I was so excited when I heard Mandy's Room 2 was in the works. I got to get back in the booth and scratch that erotica itch, this time with some really hot girl-on-girl action. Have fun playing around! I certainly did ;)[/i]

notes.title: Movement/Control Changes in Mandy's Room 2.
notes.content:
Hello all, we have just updated Mandy's Room 2 with changes to the VR control scheme that many have requested, to allow for "Rotation" in-game using the right controller. Previously in the game VR, the left and right controllers performed the exact same functions so that you could perform all of the navigation with just one hand. Now the trackpad/joystick on the right controller performs a rotating motion, rotating the camera left or right.

But BE CAREFUL! Rotating (spinning around) in VR can cause nausea (it does for me), so make sure you are comfortable with this type of motion. If you would like the controls to behave the way they did before we made this change, you can go to the settings (in the lower righthand corner of the menu screen) and choose "Disable Rotation Control in VR". This will return the old control pattern, where the only way to turn around in the game is to turn your head or spin around in your swivel chair.

Thanks again for the feedback, and we hope that this enhances the experience for all of you who were looking for a way to freely rotate the VR camera in the game.
